title: Keys for people and agents
tagline: The register, one panel at a time.
blurb: pki.sgit.ai's storyboards: how a person gets a key pair from a passkey, how two people verify each other two ways, how a secret travels by QR code and how an agent gets a key of its own. Each board links to the page where you can try it for real.

shelves.title: Keys for people
shelves.note: A passkey opens a vault, the vault holds the keys, and two people find and verify each other.

shelves.title: Keys for agents
shelves.note: An agent makes its own key, names its operator and is confirmed for a week.

shelves.title: Next: proposed
shelves.note: Boards for what is proposed and not built yet.

quotes: Every line a character says is the storyboard's, not a quote, and is marked not_a_quote; evidence panels quote pki.sgit.ai's pages word for word, which pki.sgit.ai's build checked at the origin commit.
